title: We Have To Keep Quiet (Video (Standard))
description: The night is ending after a party on campus. After spending most of the night together, two students are walking home together. I decide to invite you to stay over at my dorm for the night instead of making you walk home alone. The only problem is I'm in an all female dorm! But my roommate is asleep. ;) As long as you're gone by morning nobody will know. We just have to keep quiet so we don't wake my roommate up. We should be able to do that, right?
author: Mistress Shibby
